query: Custom LoRA-trainer (block swapping) OOMs at pinned-memory allocation on >=0.16 in WSL/5090 although RAM/VRAM are free; worked 21h on 0.9.x.

desired.outcome: Booyaka101 root-caused it: comfy-aimdo is still dlopen'd (RTLD_GLOBAL) on WSL by main.py line 45 even with dynamic VRAM disabled. OP (C1/C12) confirms --disable-dynamic-vram fixes it and that commenting out the dlopen confirms the diagnosis; fix proposed in PR #13818 (WSL guard), not yet merged at thread end.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause class; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct for this workflow.
